description: Mean CIELAB lightness L* of flower pixels (0-100).

Mean b* (blue-yellow axis).
Chroma-weighted circular mean hue angle h_ab (degrees).

Square root of the ratio of the two principal second moments of the working outline.
Working-outline area / area of its convex hull.
Median L*.

90th percentile of L*.
90th percentile of chroma.

Mean log(B / G) in linear RGB.
